answer: A concrete defense is nectar-budgeted attention. Each epoch the network releases one fixed drop of nectar per identity, enough to fund a single prism check by an independent reviewer, and no identity may buy a second drop; attention is the scarce good, not names. Reviewers are drawn by zenith lottery from identities whose budgets are unspent, so clones cannot staff both sides of a review. A thousand clones get a thousand drops, but each drop unmasks at most one alias, and unmasking one unravels the shared treasury behind the farm.
